Expose the same brief contract through CLI, HTTP, and typed MCP, and document Codex/Claude Code invocation in an installable skill package.
verify: run_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-run --brief examples/production-qualification/brief.json --output "$run_dir" && python3 -m open3d_artist validate "$run_dir"
stop_if: Any required change falls outside allowed_files.
Brief input permits arbitrary recipe paths, shell/Python execution, network access, provider calls, or unbounded filesystem access.
Recipe selection is not restricted to checked-in allowlisted recipe IDs.
CLI, HTTP, and MCP do not produce equivalent receipt semantics.
The protocol claims Codex or Claude execution without a locally verifiable invocation result.
External visual QA, Unity, Meshy, All2API, signing, or approval can appear PASS/APPROVED without evidence.
Verification fails twice without a clear local fix.
